svg.title: Blockwave Studios: Minecraft and Roblox asset marketplace. Designed and built solo, from the spec to a client-approved demo.
svg.desc: Project card for Blockwave Studios, showing real screenshots of the desktop and mobile layouts. Minecraft and Roblox asset marketplace. Designed and built solo, from the spec to a client-approved demo. Built with React 19, Vite, Tailwind v4, Recharts.
